question: When was the last time it snowed in england on christmas day?
text:
The most recent Christmas Day I could verify snow falling in **England** was **25 December 2021**, in the **Yorkshire Dales**. The UK had an official white Christmas in 2023, but that year’s recorded Christmas Day snowfall was all in Scotland. ([itv.com](https://www.itv.com/news/2021-12-25/white-christmas-expected-in-pockets-of-uk?utm_source=openai))

If you mean **widespread snow on the ground**, that was **Christmas Day 2010**. Much of England was already covered in snow. ([metoffice.gov.uk](https://www.metoffice.gov.uk/api/assets/file/factsheet_5_white_christmas_2025pdf?prefix=assets))
